Two years ago, my husband GM'd a game of D&D and presented this Pathetic Little Meow Meow™ to seduce my paladin off the Rampage Barbie Pipeline™. It worked. It worked really, [i]really[/i] well. My Baby Girl™ has evolved from a D&D NPC to having a leading role in my novel, and now I am putting him in Stardew because the Brain Rot™ has won.  

In addition to replacing the portraits and sprites, this mod also updates the sprite for the wizard teleport and the [s]portrait furniture item you earn once your relationship has progressed far enough[/s]. Apologies but the painting is not working right now. I will update soon.

A ✨[color=#ffff00]special✨ [/color]easter egg referencing my Blorbo's™ D&D heritage is included for those using RRRR or SVE. Apologies, but neither of the RomRas mods feature this neat little bonus. 

[b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
If you're new to modding Stardew, please start [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url].
This mod doesn't do anything on its own. You need one of the mods below (and their respective dependencies) for this to work.
Unpack into your mods folder and adjust settings via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[b][size=3]Compatible with:[/size]
[/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url]:[/b] Please select the [b]7[/b] portrait option and the [b]SVE[/b] sprite.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius (RomRas)[/url][b]: [/b]Please select the [b]9[/b] portrait option and the [b]RomRas[/b] sprite. 

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE Compatible (RomRasSVE)[/url]: [/b]Please select the [b]12[/b] portrait option and the [b]RomRas [/b]sprite (yes, they are the same).

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped (RRRR)[/url]: [/b]Please select the [b]32[/b] portrait option and the [b]RRRR[/b] sprite.

[b]NOTE:[/b] RRRR specifically has an option within its config to change the sprites to "use custom". Please ensure you have selected this option.

Hypatia's farmer portrait created using [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]this game[/url] by Jazzybee and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url].

I created this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ (DSV) in mind. My OC pulls from a lot of inspirations; chief among them being Freddie Mercury, Gomez Addams, and Dorian Pavus. He has brown skin and his wedding attire is inspired by traditional Palestinian wedding thobes. I'm keen to include a more accurate/elaborate design in the future with headwear. He is also canonically demisexual, and [color=#c27ba0]panr[/color][color=#ffd966]oma[/color][color=#00ffff]ntic[/color]. [b]NOTE[/b]: These things are not added to the mod, just some fun facts in case you were curious. 

[size=3][b][b]⚠️ [/b][color=#ff0000]IMPORTANT [/color][color=#ffff00]⚠️[/color][/b][/size]
I've done my best to test this mod thoroughly. Please accept my apologies in advance if you run into any issues. If the mod is loaded correctly, but you do not see the updated portraits or sprites, please try deleting any portraits/sprites from the pre-requisite mods (SVE, etc) or any seasonal mods (DSV, Cuter Aesthetic, etc.) as they may be overwriting my mod. Alternatively, you may try disabling those mods in the config menu.
